title: How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
title_zh: 智能体该记住多少？LLM 智能体自蒸馏记忆的部署经验
abstract_en: LLM agents on long-horizon tasks fail in recurring, procedural ways. They mis-paginate an API, resolve the wrong entity, or answer when no answer was asked. We built a pipeline that lets an agent learn from its own history. It first mines short \emph{lessons} from the agent's own trajectories, one to three per episode. It then consolidates those lessons into a smaller set of \emph{guidelines}, where each guideline records how many lessons it merged. At inference the agent receives either all guidelines or a selected subset. The pipeline ships in the open-source altk-evolve library and is deployed in IBM's CUGA agent and watsonx Orchestrate platform. We report what we learned building, measuring, and productizing it. Our primary instrument is the AppWorld benchmark, across models spanning 40--92\% baseline task completion. The central finding is that the right amount of memory is a property of the model, not the memory. A strong model keeps improving as guidelines are added. DeepSeek-V3.2 gains +9.5 points of task completion and +16.1 points of scenario completion with its full 191-guideline set. A weak model gains less from the same full set than from a small selected subset. gpt-oss-120b starts at 39.9\% task completion. It reaches 51.2\% with all 199 of its guidelines but 55.4\% (mean of two runs) with a selected subset of about 29. Around that result we report what went wrong: a high-support guideline that backfired, provenance silently dropped during consolidation, a swallowed API error that failed every task while producing a plausible log, and a baseline confound that nearly produced a misleading comparison with a prior method. We distill these into recommendations for teams deploying agent memory.
abstract_zh: LLM 智能体在长程任务中常重复犯下程序性错误，例如处理错 API 分页、匹配错实体，或在未被要求回答时擅自作答。本文提出一套自蒸馏记忆流程：从智能体自身的每条执行轨迹中提炼 1–3 条经验，将其归并为更少的操作准则，并记录每条准则合并了多少条经验；推理时注入全部准则或筛选后的子集。该流程已集成到开源库 altk-evolve，并部署于 IBM 的 CUGA 智能体与 watsonx Orchestrate 平台。AppWorld 上的实验覆盖基线任务完成率约为 40%–92% 的模型。核心发现是，合适的记忆量取决于模型：DeepSeek-V3.2 使用全部 191 条准则后，任务完成率和场景完成率分别提高 9.5 和 16.1 个百分点；gpt-oss-120b 的任务完成率从基线 39.9% 升至全量准则下的 51.2%，而筛选约 29 条准则后达到 55.4%（两次运行的均值）。论文还复盘了高支持度准则适得其反、归并时来源信息丢失、API 错误被吞掉，以及基线混杂可能误导方法比较等问题。
key_points_zh: 从智能体自身轨迹提炼短经验，再归并为推理时可注入的准则；每条准则保留合并经验的数量。
DeepSeek-V3.2 使用全量 191 条准则，任务完成率提高 9.5 个百分点，场景完成率提高 16.1 个百分点。
gpt-oss-120b 使用约 29 条筛选准则时，任务完成率为 55.4%，高于使用全部 199 条时的 51.2%。
部署时不能把支持度当作准则质量的保证；还应保留经验来源、显式暴露 API 错误，并核查对照基线是否可比。

llm_assessment.comment: The open-source lesson consolidation pipeline offers practical deployment value, while its AppWorld results suggest that the best memory budget depends on the model.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 开源的经验整合流程具有实际部署价值，而 AppWorld 上的结果表明，最合适的记忆用量因模型而异。
